metadata.label: En volucuis generosa minas sub arundine spernit
metadata.description:
Opening poem of the treatise Arithmologia, dedicated to the Nádasdy family. An English translation of the text is "Behold, the generous bird scorns the threats under the reed.
While they cherish the rough, forged bark.

text:
En volucuis generosa minas sub arundine spernit.
Aspera dum ficto cortice fovent.
Sic tibi securam iungis Nadasdie pasem,
Sola cui, armorum tristior umbra, quies
